experience.title: Software Engineering Intern

Added integration tests covering the 6 highest-traffic API endpoints, catching 3 regressions before release

projects.name: Transit Delay Predictor

Served predictions through a FastAPI endpoint with a 95th-percentile latency of 60 ms
